name: Julia's Cycle
source:
After hearing about the fire in the apartment building, Julia will confront guilt and the ghosts of the past as she comes to terms with the idea that she will never see Andrew again. A more introspective story about trauma, abandonment, and the decision of letting go of the past or clinging to it.
